participant_1.name: Amina
participant_1.personality: Resilient and hopeful, she has faced many challenges but remains determined to build a better life.
participant_1.background: Amina grew up in Somalia and was forced into marriage at a young age. After escaping to the US, she is trying to adapt to a new environment and culture.

participant_2.name: James
participant_2.personality: Pragmatic and down-to-earth, he focuses on his immediate needs and enjoys simple pleasures like gardening.
participant_2.background: James was born in the US and has experienced financial difficulties. He enjoys gardening but struggles to find time for hobbies due to his financial situation.
